cases.expected: TradingRecord containing trades generated from the whole BarSeries (startIndex = barSeries.getBeginIndex(), finishIndex = barSeries.getEndIndex())
cases.description: Valid strategy, trade type and amount should result in a non‑null TradingRecord with trades produced by the strategy over the full series.
A strategy that never signals an entry should produce an empty TradingRecord even though the amount and trade type are valid.
When the amount is zero, the manager should not open any position; the resulting TradingRecord must be empty.
Passing a null Strategy must cause the method to reject the call with an exception.
A null TradeType is not allowed; the method should throw an exception.
A null amount must be rejected with an exception.
If the underlying BarSeries is empty (beginIndex > endIndex), the manager should return an empty TradingRecord without throwing.

cases.expected: TradingRecord with a single trade opened at the last bar and closed immediately (if exit condition is also true)
cases.description: When the start and finish indices are the same (single‑bar series), the method must still evaluate the strategy for that bar and produce the appropriate trade(s).
A negative amount is not a valid investment size; the manager should reject the call with an IllegalArgumentException.
If the supplied strategy throws an unchecked exception while being evaluated, the run method must not swallow it; the exception should propagate to the caller.

cases.expected: TradingRecord containing exactly 2 trades: first from index 0 to 2, second from index 3 to 5
cases.description: A strategy that signals entry at bar 0, exit at bar 2, re‑entry at bar 3 and exit at bar 5 should produce a TradingRecord with two distinct trades covering those index ranges.

cases.expected: TradingRecord containing trades only for bars with index 5‑10 (the series' beginIndex‑endIndex)
cases.description: When the underlying BarSeries is constructed so that getBeginIndex() returns 5 and getEndIndex() returns 10, the run method must evaluate the strategy only on that window and produce trades limited to those indices.

group: TradeType mismatch – strategy signals opposite direction

cases.description: If the strategy only generates SELL signals but the caller restricts the run to BUY trades, the manager should ignore those signals and return an empty TradingRecord.

cases.expected: TradingRecord with trades where each entry and exit amount is reduced by the configured transaction cost (e.g., 0.1% per trade)
cases.description: When a non‑zero TransactionCostModel is set on the BarSeriesManager, the run method must apply the cost to every trade; the test verifies that the resulting trades reflect the deducted cost.

cases.expected: TradingRecord with trades correctly created; no ArithmeticException or overflow occurs
cases.description: Using the maximum possible long value as the amount should be handled gracefully; the manager must not throw an overflow‑related exception and should still generate the expected trades.

BarSeriesManager is instantiated with a null BarSeries; calling run should immediately throw a NullPointerException because the internal call to barSeries.getBeginIndex() dereferences a null reference.
